_note: S334 (audit items 9 and 13). The site has three clusters where several surfaces answer overlapping questions and none of them says how it differs from its neighbours: membership/identity (8 surfaces), editorial (8 surfaces), and evidence (handled separately by /evidence/). This file states, for each page, what it IS in one line and which sibling to use instead when the visitor wants the other thing. It is orientation, not navigation — the site nav still routes; this stops a visitor landing on the wrong one of three near-identical doors and bouncing. Every href is resolved against the tree at build time. S334: news/index.html is deliberately NOT in this list — generate-news-pages.mjs owns that file and rewrites it, so a strip injected here would be clobbered on every build and would make generate-news-pages --check permanently stale. The three surfaces that actually confuse a visitor (/journal/, /changelog/, /notebook/ — the same record at three granularities) carry the disambiguation; The Desk is distinctive enough to stand without it. S368 ia-consolidation-v2: /members/, /notebook/ and the /journal/ index retired (301 to /community/#members, /studio-pulse/#forge-ledger and /changelog/#stories).
